page.layout: One printed page: a title page inside an ornamental woodcut border, with a central woodcut emblem (eagle and figures) and the imprint below. Handwritten shelfmarks in pencil at top and bottom are not printed and are left out.
page.notes: The emblem in the centre (an eagle or phoenix between two figures on a pedestal) is a woodcut and is not transcribed. Pencilled marks outside the border ("Phys. g. 630 c", "Goclenii - Reuss", "265") are library annotations and are left out.
